variants.description: The algorithm-development template as the install runs it: develop:1, review:1 with remediation cycles on another session, validate:1, then the run's required checks.
A review's fix continues the writing step's own session on its Worker, the findings sent as its next message (T232). Ready once T232 lands and can be turned on by configuration alone.
The template without validate:1: the run's required checks at acceptance are the only checks. Ready once a configuration can leave the step out.
